summary: Baseline still collecting after two substantial sessions. Communication can be sustained on familiar and semi-familiar topics, with promising repair and clarification behavior. Fluency and grammatical control remain variable under real-time pressure, especially during lexical search and longer spontaneous turns.

range.note: Can discuss familiar interests, hypothetical situations, travel problems and interpersonal boundaries; broader sampling is still needed.

accuracy.note: Meaning is usually recoverable, but agreement, prepositions and sentence assembly become unstable under time pressure.

fluency.note: Can sustain extended turns, but frequent restarts, fillers and word-by-word construction remain visible.

interaction.note: Regularly asks for clarification, redirects topics when needed and keeps conversational intent clear.

coherence.note: Longer opinions are understandable, though organization can loosen when searching for language.
